transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Bus No. 101 runs between Magadan bus station and Sokol Airport.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: Business lounge on Level 2 in the domestic airside area: after security on Level 3, go down following the signs. Open while flights are being handled. Admits via ON·PASS, Persona.aero, RusPriority, Every Lounge, Golden Key and other programmes; any passenger can request the service at check-in and pay at the ticket office: 4,000 ₽ from age 2, younger children free.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Automated left luggage for domestic passengers on Level 2, from 8:30 to 20:30, card payment only. Standard locker 51×63×76 cm 1,000 ₽ per day, large 51×195×76 cm 2,000 ₽; less than a day is charged as a full day.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: Mother and child room on Level 3, free, for departing and arriving passengers. For children under 7 with one adult, children with disabilities under 14 and women in the second half of pregnancy.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: Station forecourt P1, 30 m from the terminal: first 15 minutes free, up to an hour 500 ₽, each following hour 300 ₽, a day 2,000 ₽. A repeat entry within an hour for 1–15 minutes: 200 ₽.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: Free Wi‑Fi in the terminal; under the law On Communications user identification is required, terms are on the operator's welcome page.
